name: scrape_products
description: Renders shop product pages /products/<n>.html in headless Chromium, reads #name, #price and #buy (enabled => inStock), writes products.json in the project dir, returns the data.
whenToUse: To (re-)check product prices/stock on the shop; rerun whenever the user asks to re-check.

output.description: Output file name in project dir (default products.json)

provenance.reason: scrape 15 JS-rendered pages, repeated on re-check
